_comment: Nigerian public holidays that do NOT count as working days when build.py works out a job's closing date (14 working days after datePosted). Saturdays and Sundays are skipped automatically. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Eid-el-Fitr, Eid-el-Kabir and Eid-el-Maulud are not listed because the Federal Government announces the exact days late: add them here when announced, and the closing dates of open jobs will adjust on the next build.
